codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly hardens NumPy conversion in src/embedding.py by adding .detach().cpu() before .numpy() on both conversion sites. This ensures GPU/MPS compatibility by properly detaching tensors from the computation graph and moving them to CPU memory before numpy conversion. The fix is minimal, targeted, and follows PyTorch best practices for cross-device compatibility.
